data.one_liner: Collection of custom layout widgets, behavioral helpers, formatters, and dialog utilities.
data.what_it_does: Provides a large library of specialized layout widgets (like SideBySide, RowSuper, WrapSuper, ColumnSuper), custom form text input formatters, keyboard management helpers, dialog utilities, and UI enhancements.
use_when: You need advanced horizontal or wrapping layouts that standard Row, Column, and Wrap widgets cannot easily achieve.
You want custom text input formatters for masking, thousands separators, or email validation.
You need keyboard detection, dismissal, or keyboard-aware widgets.
avoid_when: You only need standard Material layout components and wish to keep your dependency tree minimal.
You are looking for a complete UI design system or full state management framework.
strengths: Extensive collection of specialized widgets and text formatters in a single package.
Tree-shaking friendly so unused widgets are removed.
Provides unique layout capabilities like SideBySide and WrapSuper.
weaknesses: The package covers many diverse topics, making it a bit of a grab-bag rather than a focused tool.
Has breaking changes across major versions requiring manual migration of imports and parameters.
